topography.project_purpose: Onchain Capital Allocator. Structurally: 54 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 9 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 6 common project-authored base contract(s) (basedscontract, serviceconsumer, idsserviceconsumer). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
